fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Local anaesthetic, then the tooth is shaped for a crown exactly as it would be conventionally. Old filling material and any decay come out at this stage.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: A small camera captures the prepared tooth, the opposing teeth and your bite in a few minutes. No trays, no putty, no waiting with your mouth full.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The crown is designed on screen against your own bite, then milled from a ceramic block in the practice. Roughly 15 to 30 minutes - time you can spend relaxing privately in your own room in a massage chair, or in the waiting area, where our premium coffee machine makes your favourite brew at the touch of a button.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The crown is characterised and glazed to match your teeth, then tried in, adjusted for bite and bonded into place. You leave with the finished tooth.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: You can eat as soon as the anaesthetic wears off - there’s no cement waiting period as with some temporaries.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Mild gum tenderness around the tooth for a day or two is normal.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Cold sensitivity can persist for a couple of weeks, especially after a deep preparation.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Come back if the bite feels high - a quick adjustment prevents ongoing discomfort.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Floss around the crown daily; the margin is where problems start.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Wear a night splint if you grind - ceramic chips under sustained load.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Still the better choice for certain aesthetics on front teeth, multi-unit bridges, and some complex bite cases. Two appointments and a temporary in between.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Where enough sound tooth remains, a partial-coverage restoration preserves more of your own tooth.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: If the tooth is cracked below the gum or has lost too much support, crowning it only delays the inevitable. We’ll say so rather than take the fee.

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: No treatment is risk-free, and you should hear this before you decide rather than afterwards.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: CEREC is not suitable for every case. Some front-tooth aesthetics, multi-unit bridges and certain bite situations are still better handled by a dental laboratory, where a technician can layer porcelain by hand.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: The appointment is long - typically two hours or more in one sitting. Some people find that harder than two shorter visits.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Preparing a tooth for a crown is irreversible, exactly as with a conventional crown.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Around one in ten crowned teeth eventually needs root canal treatment because the nerve is irritated by preparation.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Ceramic can chip or fracture, particularly in people who grind or clench.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Milled monolithic ceramic is strong, but very high-translucency front teeth can be marginally harder to match than hand-layered porcelain.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Crowns are not permanent - ten to fifteen years or more is typical, then replacement.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Same-day crowns are usually priced comparably to laboratory crowns, and you save a second appointment and the temporary. Most health funds rebate under major dental, though annual limits are often reached with a single crown. Interest-free payment plans are available.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Before anything starts you’ll have a written treatment plan with costs, inclusions and any conditions spelled out, plus an estimate of your health fund rebate checked at the desk.
